## Landed — Gerrit change 3161, merged

Commit `aef719a7bdab9b027f432ff84005eacbb436eb44` (patchset 2), `LLM-Review +1` + `Verified +1`, submitted revision-scoped.

`make verify` PASSED on the implementation: 20,059 passed, 28 skipped, exit 0.

### Recorded deviations from the plan

**1. The plan named 3 doc locators; the tree has 4.**

The Change section listed `docs/adr/0073-reopen-invalidation-validity-on-read.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, and one `docs/event-schema.md` site. Sweeping the symbol across the whole tree rather than sampling found a **fourth** reference at `docs/event-schema.md:256`, in a second passage describing the same re-export set. Left unedited it would have survived as a stale claim that the shim still exists. It is corrected in the landed change.

**2. AC5 says "5 patch sites"; 3 are present.**

AC5's count was carried over from an earlier draft of the slice boundary. The actual re-export block holds **7** names, and the importer set is **5 modules** (`src/rebar/reducer/_replay.py` plus 4 test modules) — not 5 patch sites. The AC's intent (every importer is repointed and each one's test fails without the repoint) is met; its arithmetic was wrong. This is the same latent-AC defect class recorded on `dc42-...`, `db2c-3a4b-1826-451f`, `a018-a2c0-fc15-434c`, and `25a4-1ab3-3558-4cd4`: an AC that pins an exact count measured at planning time, against a tree that moved.

### Base-carried CI failure — worth recording

Patchset 1 took `Verified -1` while local `make verify` had passed. Root cause was **not** this change: the worktree branched from a base predating `778c969e4f1`, so `.github/workflows/release.yml:283` still pinned `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` to v1.14.2, and CI's zizmor flagged GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 under `known-vulnerable-actions`. The local zizmor did not flag that advisory. Rebasing onto current `origin/main` cleared it, and Gerrit **copied** `LLM-Review +1` across the rebase (`changekind:NO_CODE_CHANGE`), so the review was not re-spent.

Check a worktree's base before pushing: `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD`.
